splash:wordmark__note: The product name. NOT translated — it is a brand name, and a translated one is a different product. Present so the splash has no hardcoded string, and so a locale that needs a transliteration can have one.
splash:slow__note: Shown only after 1.2s of boot. Says the app is working; never apologises and never blames the connection, which may not be the problem. Max 32 characters.
splash:failed.title: That took too long
splash:failed.title__note: Shown after 10s of boot. States the fact without blaming the user or the device. Max 24 characters.
splash:failed.body: Something got stuck on the way in. Let's try that again.
splash:failed.body__note: Body of the failed-boot state. Warm, brief, and followed by a retry button — a splash with no way out looks identical to a crash.
